_comment: Sheets match without case; a trailing slash selects a family. UI catalogs are not Excel sheets.
Descriptions are optional English text. Gubal finds translations and screenshots by node ID path.
inventoryGroupBy lists inventory-only levels. rowId is the numeric ID after #, before an optional text-column suffix.
Quest expansion comes only from quest metadata; other content stays global. Missing or conflicting links remain unassigned.
Rules use first-match order. Each when value is a case-insensitive regular expression; all fields must match. Rules with the same id share one group.

when.genre: ^(?:Zodiac Weapons|Anima Weapons|The Forbidden Land, Eureka|Resistance Weapons|Manderville Weapons|Phantom Weapons)$
